text:
andrea: quick sync — we need a concrete UX for automatic fallback during rollouts. idea: show a live "soft switch" preview with an explicit "instant roll-in" affordance for operators. thoughts?
viv: love the preview idea. two important ops constraints: show exact QPS affected and how many requests were degraded. otherwise operators won't trust the button. :eyes:
omar: agree on metrics. also need to differentiate "soft degrade" (tolerate partial outputs) vs "hard fallback" (fully route to simpler model). UX should make that explicit in one line.
cheng: telemetry side: record an immutable event per policy decision with a small snapshot (policy id, trigger, sample of requests ids). searchable. audit exportable as newline-delimited JSON for SRE/playback.
kai: small API thought: add POST /v1/rollouts/:id/simulate that returns estimated QPS and token delta for N minutes. UI can fetch this before operator hits the roll-in button.
andrea: good call. the simulate endpoint should also return a sample of matched traces (if sample_rate>0) — opt-in by org. privacy-safe.
maya: operator flow: when they hit "instant roll-in" show a compact diff: 
- policy change summary
- estimated cost delta
- affected routes list (max 10)
- a 1-click undo with cooldown (e.g., 2m).
viv: on cooldowns: we should show a cooldown graph (last 30m) so they know if flip-flopping will oscillate. maybe disable undo for 30s to avoid thrash.
omar: triggers: many threads conflate 5xx, 429, and model-assert errors. For rollout UX let's map to user-friendly buckets: infra (429/503), correctness (model hallucination/error), latency. UI should explain mapping.
cheng: audit retention: default 7d full, with 90d aggregated. UI should show when the detailed snapshot will expire and offer export.
kai: policy example (for UI preview):
```
mode: "soft_degrade"
trigger: "5xx_rate>0.03 || p95_latency>1200"
auditing: "sample_rate: 0.2, persist: true"
handback: "operator"
```
andrea: nice. UX question: do we animate the preview by replaying sampled traces in a sandbox timeline? interactive replay could help ops trust the effect.
maya: +1 but keep it optional. heavy replays should be behind a "run replay" button and only for canary windows.
viv: small nit: show who last edited the policy and provide a quick link to changelist + commit hash. makes audits actionable.
omar: about the operator quick-revert: enforce an access log entry that records actor, IP, and reason (free text). show that in the audit table.
andrea: ok actionable todo list: 1) frontend: preview modal with estimated qps + affected routes + cooldown UX 2) backend: /simulate endpoint + sampled trace snapshot export 3) telemetry: immutable decision events + retention policy UI 4) guardrails: disable undo for X seconds and show cooldown graph 5) docs + small playbook.
cheng: I'll draft the telemetry schema and retention knobs.
kai: I'll spec the simulate API (body & response).
maya: I'll mock the modal copy and minimal wire.
viv: I'll add operator safety text for the undo affordance.
release-bot: Canary 7322: 3% traffic routed to v2, no fallbacks triggered in last 10m. :white_check_mark:
andrea: thanks all. ping me on PRs. I'll schedule a 30m design huddle tomorrow to align on copy and the sample rates.
viv: thanks — love the practical checklists.
omar: good session.
